NEW: Trump says renewed U.S. strikes on Iran are “highly unlikely” if Tehran makes progress toward a nuclear deal and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
“It depends on whether or not they sign a very strong agreement,” Trump told CNN, adding, “I would if necessary, but we hit them really hard.” 
He warned that U.S. forces remain ready, saying, “I’ve got three aircraft carriers here. They’re fully locked and loaded.”
Trump also claimed the U.S. could destroy 38 Iranian bridges within an hour and that Iran retains only 10% of its missile capacity and 15% of its drone capabilities. 
Despite the threats, he insisted, “Most likely it will not be necessary. They want to make a deal so badly.”
Source: CNN

⚔️🇸🇦 Houthis pound Saudi territory with retaliatory strikes
Using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones, the Houthis hit a series of Saudi targets, the movement’s spokesman Brigadier General Yahya Saree declared.
🔴 The first set of targets included the “Khalid International Airport, Aramco oil storage tanks and Financial Center in Riyadh”
🔴 The second wave was directed at Aramco sites in the Saudi city of Abqaiq
🔴 The third targeted Saudi-led troop concentrations in the Saudi province of al-Jawf and in the Ma’rib Governorate in Yemen
🔴 The fourth wave was aimed at the Saudi-led troop formations in the Lahj Governorate in Yemen
The attacks were carried out in response for the earlier Saudi strikes against civilian targets in Yemen, such as the “massacres at the Al-Hadara market in Al-Waziyah and the residential buildings in Bani Hashish,” which resulted in numerous casualties, including women and children, noted Saree.
He also promised that the Houthis will continue their attacks into the Saudi territory “to avenge the blood of our people and deter the Saudi aggressor.»
